author: josh1125
text: I know it's been a while. I had to take a step back, and find myself as a trader again. I felt like I was going through an identity crisis as of who I really was as a trader. After being promoted, I started receiving several PMs, as people began to ask me about several concepts I really never quite understood. It wasn't until going through Mertch's journal again, that I realized just because the way I processed the information here on RTM, may be a little different than the way other's have isn't a bad thing. I had to remind myself that I've understood RTM concepts in a way that makes sense, and works for me. Each of us will take different paths to achieve the same goal. IF has given us a map, with several roads, but they all end in the same place. You may not understand everything, but find something, and become an expert. Mertch, the master of QM and Diamond trading. He became an expert, and he is by far one of the greatest traders I have ever come across. Salivan, master of free order flow. Staurum, one of the best LS QM+DM traders I know. Each one of these traders took something taught by IF, perfected it, and made it their own. We must all do the same. I had to remind myself that I may not completely understand all of IF's concepts, but the concepts I do understand, I have perfected, and made my own.

text: It's amazing how a hand full of people can control the lives of many. This morning I received word that I won't be returning to work due the the government shutdown. How can a disagreement between a few hundred people impact the lives of many. This is a prime example of the mission of RTM and blue dot project. In the world's current state, we the people have no voice. Until change has come, we are still slaves to all of our governments. During my time of "furlough", I will continue to hone my rtm skills, so one day I can help change the world.
